title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 2, 2019
raw_text:
Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 2, 2019

A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum

For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum.

For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

BUG FIXES

General

- Workshop: Fixed the “Disable Built-In Game Mode Respawning” and “Set Respawn Max Time” actions.
- Replays: Added Replay keybinding options

Heroes

Baptiste

- Fixed a bug where Baptiste's Amplification Matrix was not boosting healing effects.

Live Patch Notes

These patch notes represent general changes made to the Live version of Overwatch and the balance changes listed affect Quick Play, Competitive Play, Arcade, and Custom Games.
